MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLED.title: 启用联机配置同步 / Enable MP config sync
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLED.hover.desc: 开启后: 作为主机时, 每次联机开局自动把本机全部 mod 配置下发给所有队友; 作为队友时, 接受主机下发的配置并写入本地. 两端都开启才生效. / When enabled: as host, push all local mod configs to every peer at multiplayer run start; as peer, accept and apply the host's config. Both ends must enable it.
